description: Set up the Hono.js + Cloudflare Workers project scaffolding with wrangler configuration, project structure, and core infrastructure (database connection via Hyperdrive to existing PostgreSQL, R2 bindings, KV bindings, Queue bindings, environment variable schema). This creates the foundation that all subsequent features build upon.
steps: Create a new apps/api/ directory for the Hono.js Cloudflare Workers API application

Initialize package.json with dependencies: hono, @hono/zod-validator, drizzle-orm, pg (or postgres), zod, superjson, stripe, @slack/web-api, octokit, resend, @react-email/components, quickbooks-node-promise, @docuseal/api, @ai-sdk/openai, ai, bcrypt (or bcryptjs for Workers compatibility), nanoid, date-fns, decimal.js, lodash-es, jsonwebtoken
Add devDependencies: wrangler, @cloudflare/workers-types, typescript, drizzle-kit, vitest, @types/pg

Create wrangler.toml with: name='flexile-api', compatibility_date, node_compat=true, Hyperdrive binding (to connect to existing PostgreSQL), R2 bucket binding (replacing S3), KV namespace bindings (for caching/sessions), Queue bindings (for background jobs replacing Inngest/Sidekiq), D1 binding (optional, for metadata), environment variables list matching apps/next/env/index.ts
Create tsconfig.json targeting ES2022 with module=ESNext, moduleResolution=bundler, types=['@cloudflare/workers-types'], paths aliases matching @/ pattern
Create src/index.ts as the main Hono app entry point with base middleware (CORS, error handling, request ID, logging)
Create src/env.ts to define typed environment bindings (Env interface) for Cloudflare Workers matching all vars from apps/next/env/index.ts and apps/next/env/client.ts
Create src/db/index.ts to set up Drizzle ORM connection via Hyperdrive (using the pg driver with Hyperdrive's connection string), export the db instance
Copy and adapt apps/next/db/schema.ts to src/db/schema.ts - remove 'server-only' import, update import paths for encryptedField utilities, keep all table definitions intact
Copy apps/next/db/enums.ts to src/db/enums.ts
Copy apps/next/db/json.ts to src/db/json.ts
Create src/storage/r2.ts - R2 client utilities replacing S3 (getSignedUrl equivalent using R2 presigned URLs, upload, delete operations)
Create src/middleware/auth.ts - Clerk JWT verification middleware for Cloudflare Workers (verify JWT from Authorization header using Clerk's JWKS endpoint, extract userId)

Create src/middleware/company.ts - Company context middleware that resolves companyId from request params and validates user access (port logic from apps/next/trpc/index.ts protectedProcedure and companyProcedure)
Create src/lib/stripe.ts - Stripe client initialization (port from apps/next/lib/stripe.ts)
Create src/lib/quickbooks.ts - QuickBooks client setup (port from apps/next/lib/quickbooks.ts)
Create src/lib/github.ts - GitHub/Octokit setup (port from apps/next/lib/github.ts)
Create src/lib/email.ts - Resend email client setup (port from apps/next/trpc/email.tsx)
Create src/lib/slack.ts - Slack web API client initialization
Create src/utils/ directory and port utility files from apps/next/utils/ (assert.ts, formatMoney.ts, numbers.ts, time.ts, pluralize.ts)
Create vitest.config.ts for unit testing with miniflare environment
Create a basic health check route at GET /health that returns 200 with version info
Add scripts to package.json: dev (wrangler dev), build (wrangler build), deploy (wrangler deploy), test (vitest), typecheck (tsc --noEmit)
acceptance_criteria: apps/api/package.json exists with all required dependencies
wrangler.toml is valid and defines all bindings (Hyperdrive, R2, KV, Queues)
src/index.ts exports a valid Hono app with health check endpoint
src/db/schema.ts contains all table definitions from the original schema
src/middleware/auth.ts exports a Clerk JWT verification middleware
src/env.ts defines the Env interface with all required bindings and secrets
verification: Run 'cd apps/api && npx tsc --noEmit' to verify TypeScript compilation
Run 'cd apps/api && npx wrangler dev --dry-run' or validate wrangler.toml syntax
findings: npm registry is blocked by the sandbox proxy (403 Forbidden), so node_modules cannot be installed and full tsc --noEmit with dependency resolution cannot be run. All TypeScript files were verified to transpile correctly using the global tsc installation. The encryptedField utility was adapted from Node.js crypto to Web Crypto API for Workers compatibility; the sync fromDriver/toDriver functions pass through values since Web Crypto is async - actual decrypt must be done at application layer. The schema.ts was copied intact (3039 lines) with only the server-only import removed.
